summary: First E2E smoke test of NEGOTIA MVP. Backend and frontend core flows are working. Login, scenarios (12), full negotiation lifecycle (create → message → end with AI feedback) confirmed via API. Frontend: landing, auth, dashboard, scenarios grid + filters, and auth protection all pass. LLM integration latency ~18s for first AI reply, ~7s for end/feedback.
passed: Backend /api/auth/login returns token+user (HTTP 200) for demo@negotia.app / Demo1234!
Backend /api/scenarios returns 12 seeded scenarios wrapped as {scenarios:[...]}, HTTP 200
Security: participants in /api/scenarios do NOT expose hidden_interests, batna, or reservation_point
Backend POST /api/negotiations creates negotiation (uses scenario_slug), state.round=0, trust/pressure/signals initialized
Backend POST /api/negotiations/:id/message returns AI reply from Claude (~18s), state.round increments to 1, trust updates from 50→55, signals updated
Backend POST /api/negotiations/:id/end returns score (54), outcome ('Weak outcome'), feedback.did_well (3), feedback.improve (3), critical_moment, better_alternative, final_agreement
Frontend landing loads with hero 'Practice Negotiations...' and hero-start CTA
Sign In with demo credentials lands on /dashboard, KPIs visible, new-sim-btn present
/scenarios shows exactly 12 scenario cards; filter-category and filter-difficulty controls present
Auth protection: removing negotia_token from localStorage and visiting /dashboard redirects to /auth

failed.issue: POST /api/negotiations/:id/end returns feedback with EMPTY 'skills' object ({}). Spec requires 8-skill radar on debrief page; Debrief.jsx may render an empty/broken radar.
failed.evidence: feedback keys = ['did_well','improve','critical_moment','better_alternative','final_agreement']; feedback.skills = {} (0 keys). Users' aggregate skills at /api/users/me/stats do return 8 skills, but per-negotiation debrief does not include a per-session skill breakdown.

failed.issue: POST /api/negotiations requires 'scenario_slug' (not 'scenario_id') per 422 validation error. Ensure SimulationWizard sends scenario_slug. Not a bug if frontend already does — flagging so main agent can verify wizard payload.
failed.evidence: POST with {scenario_id: ...} => 422 'scenario_slug field required'. POST with {scenario_slug:'salary-negotiation'} => 200.

action_items: Ensure per-negotiation debrief feedback includes an 8-skill radar (feedback.skills) so Debrief.jsx radar renders; or make Debrief.jsx compute session skills from state.signals if that's the intended design.
Verify SimulationWizard payload uses scenario_slug (matches backend contract).
notes: Did not test: register-new-user, full wizard 6-step UI (skipped due to time; API path is verified), Voice mode UI, History page, Profile page radar, Make-a-Deal / Walk-Away UI buttons (verified via /end API). Recommend full testing agent cover these post-first-finish.
